notes:
Source files read: E:/Projects/IDCOL 2.0/Loan Repayment Schedule (The Heart)/IHL/IHL_Loan_Restructured.xlsx and .../IHL_Loan_2nd restructured_Jun'22.xlsx (via openpyxl, data_only=True; no ~$ lock files present). Cross-checked against the original schedule in .../IHL/IHL_Loan.xlsx and against EX_DATA['IHL'] in frontend/lib/examples.ts (Sonnet confirmed identical original disbursement 150,000,000 on 2018-01-18, rate 10%, 20 annuity installments, matching serial dates through 2020-06-30).

Both restructured workbooks are FULL lifecycle schedules (from original 2018 disbursement to final maturity), not stub files, so each version's params object was built by (a) locating the first row where terms/values diverge from the prior version, (b) using the closing balance of the last shared row as the rolled-forward "loan_amount"/disbursement for the new version's effective date, and (c) pinning every subsequent row via opening_balance_amounts / interest_payment_amounts / closing_balance_amounts overrides (not first-principles annuity formulas), because both events mix irregular stub periods, mid-quarter rate changes, and partial-cash/capitalization splits that a clean annuity recompute could not reproduce exactly.

Version 1 ("1st Restructured", IHL_Loan_Restructured.xlsx): the workbook's 'IHL_Loan' sheet explicitly documents a "Revised Interest Rate" of 9% (from 10%) with an effective-date annotation of 2020-07-01, plus an "Extension - Interest Capitalization" note pushing the principal moratorium out (original schedule had principal starting 2020-03-30 per EX_DATA/IHL_Loan.xlsx; this restructure fully capitalizes through 2020-12-31 and only starts principal at 2021-03-29). Divergence from the original begins at the 2020-09-30 installment row (first row actually priced at 9%), so the version's own schedule starts there with loan_amount = 191,707,587.16 (closing balance as of 2020-06-30, the last date still under original 10% terms) disbursed on 2020-07-01 (the documented effective date). Tenor extends from 84 months (from 2018-01-18 drawdown to original 2025-01-18 maturity) to 95 months (final row 2025-12-30). capitalizedAmount = 50,632,997.17 is the workbook's own "Interest Capitalized" cell (cumulative interest rolled into principal through the full capitalization run, 2018-2020). No overdue amounts existed (this is a pre-emptive moratorium extension, not arrears cure) and no true waiver was found, so overdueAmountRolledIn and waivedAmount are both 0. regulatoryReference: none stated in the workbook (no DFIM circular / BB-approval text found in either the IHL_Loan, Summary, or Disbursement sheets) — set to null.

Version 2 ("2nd Restructured", IHL_Loan_2nd restructured_Jun'22.xlsx): filename and an explicit in-sheet label "Repayment deferral and Interest capitalization (part) - 2nd restructuring" mark a second event. Divergence from Version 1 begins exactly at the 2021-03-29 installment (Version 1 already resumed full principal+interest there; Version 2 instead shows a partial-interest-only deferral: cash collected of only 1,500,000/quarter for 2021-03-29, then zero cash for 2021-06-30 and 2021-09-30, with the shortfall capitalized into the balance each quarter, before full-interest debt service resumes 2021-12-30 and principal amortization resumes 2022-06-30 with "extension of tenure - 2nd Restructuring" running 20 more installments through 2027-12-30). No rate change accompanied this event (stays 9%), so per the task's rule this would normally be a pure repayment deferral, but because it also re-extends the amortization tenor (not just the rate) it is classified RESTRUCTURE rather than RATE_CHANGE or a plain MORATORIUM_EXTENSION, consistent with the instruction that only a rate-only change should be RATE_CHANGE. loan_amount/effective disbursement = 200,632,997.17 (closing balance as of 2020-12-31, the last row identical in both restructured files) on 2021-03-29. Tenor extends from 95 months (Version 1) to 119 months (final row 2027-12-30, from 2018-01-18 drawdown). capitalizedAmount = 12,436,817.85 is the sum of (interest accrued − cash actually collected) across the four stub quarters 2021-03-29 through 2021-12-30, computed directly from the workbook's Interest Payment vs Total Debt Service columns (2,913,925.94 + 4,732,465.96 + 4,790,425.95 + 0 = 12,436,817.85; the 2021-12-30 quarter collected its interest in full so contributed 0 to capitalization that quarter). No overdue-arrears rollover or true forgiveness found (overdueAmountRolledIn = 0, waivedAmount = 0). regulatoryReference: null — no BB/DFIM circular citation found anywhere in the workbook.

Minor residual reconciliation note: the 2nd-restructure workbook carries small residual "diff" columns (~BDT 0.01-3 differences, e.g. -2,913,925.94 vs interest of 4,413,925.94 at one row, and small rounding deltas of ~0.06-2.7 BDT at several rows) that appear to be the workbook author's own rounding/reconciliation check columns rather than substantive figures; the core Opening/Interest/Principal/Closing Balance columns (used for all params/verification above) tie out cleanly row-to-row (each closing = opening + interest - principal, and each next row's opening = prior closing) and the final closing balance is exactly 0 in both versions, confirming full amortization by version end.
